user: What if renewable output drops 30 %? Compare with the baseline over the week.

grid.name: PGLib IEEE 30-Bus System (Alsac–Stott)
grid.description: Synthetic 7-day profile generated from the bundled PGLib IEEE 30-bus (Alsac–Stott) MATPOWER case: five dispatchable units with their own costs, line ratings from PGLib.

renewables_scaled.basis: every static generator (the semantic layer is switched off in the studies)

load_power_factor.applies_to: measured loads (Q = P·tan(acos pf)); the nominal point keeps the case's own Q

assistant:
The **30% renewable reduction and baseline are identical** in the forecast week (6–12 January, 672 intervals): each shows **97 violations**, with the worst point at **6 January 19:15**. The baseline already has violations, so the scan does not show a new increase under the reduced-output case.

The important caveat is that the model reports **no renewable units included in the scan**. That means the 0.70 scaling had no modeled generation to reduce; these results **do not establish that an actual 30% renewable drop would have no effect**.

In both scenarios, the violations were on **Bus_0 → Bus_1 [L0]** (54 intervals), **Bus_29** (41), and **Bus_28** (2). Maximum external-grid import was **252.39 MW** in each.
